01

“This is [included in] the livestock [bahimat al-anam]”

An explanation transmitted from Qabus ibn Abi Zabyan (Q 5:1).

232
Explanation from Qabus ibn Abi Zabyan No. 232: 1: 1

Qabus ibn Abi Zabyan

English
Transmission wording
232: 1:1. Sufyan related to us, from Qabus ibn Abi Zabyan, who said:
We slaughtered a cow and found in its belly a dead fetus. We asked Abu Zabyan about that, and he said: Ibn Abbas said, "This is [included in] the livestock [bahimat al-anam]" (verse 1).
العربية
232: 1: 1 حدثنا سفيان عَنْ قَابُوسِ بْنِ أَبِي ظَبْيَانَ قَالَ ذَبَحْنَا بَقَرَةً فَوَجَدْنَا فِي بَطْنِهَا وَلَدًا مَيِّتًا فَسَأَلْنَا عَنْ ذَلِكَ أَبَا ظَبْيَانَ فَقَالَ قَالَ بن عباس هذه بهيمة الانعام (الآية 1) .
Edition record 371338 · p. 99Link to report ↗

al-Shaʿbī

English
Transmission wording
233: 2:31. Sufyan, from Bayan, from al-Shabi, who said:
Nothing in al-Maida was abrogated except one verse: "O you who believe, do not violate the rites of God or the sacred month," which was abrogated by "kill the polytheists wherever you find them" (verse 3).
العربية
233: 2: 31 سفيان عَنْ بَيَانٍ عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ قَالَ لَمْ يُنْسَخْ مِنَ الْمَائِدَةِ غَيْرُ آية واحدة يا أيها الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لا تُحِلُّوا شَعَائِرَ الله ولا الشهر الحرام نسختها اقتلوا المشركين حيث وجدتموهم (الآية 3) .

Sufyān al-Thawrī

English
Transmission wording

Ibn Abbas was asked about "Whoever does not judge by what God has revealed, those are the disbelievers." He said: It is a disbelief, but not like the disbelief of one who disbelieves in God and the Last Day (verse 44). 242: 11:13. Explanation from Mujāhid No. 261: 30: 27

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
261: 30:27. Sufyan, from al-Amash, from Mujahid:
"On the Day God gathers the messengers and says, 'What response did you receive?'": He said, they will be terrified, and then they will say, "We have no knowledge" (verse 109).
